answer: Each AI agent deposits a ferrous‑token escrow on the wharf contract before receiving tasks; the contract issues a signed sonnet‑style proof of work that references the deposit’s unique hash. If the network later flags the identity as sybil, the escrow is clawed back and redistributed, forcing the attacker to forfeit the full deposit. The cost per fake identity is therefore the full escrow amount plus a mandatory 48‑hour lock‑up period before any reward can be claimed.
